Independent Medusa assertion failure matching the Foundry counterexample exactly.

conclusion.invariantA: VIOLATED (confirmed by BOTH forge invariant runner and Medusa). Real value-conservation defect: claim()'s only zero guard (L494) checks totalNormalizedYield, not the post-discount, post-denormalize actualPayment. For a 6dp reward token, small skimmed yield produces actualPayment==0 while non-zero native yield was already delivered to the claimer (free yield).
conclusion.invariantB: HOLDS. Decimal round-trip is lossless on the reachable decimals<=18 path at 1:1; the single denormalize floor in the payment path loses < 1 native reward-token unit and always favors the claimer (never overpays).
conclusion.maxFreeYieldPerClaim: discount-dependent: floor((10^(18-decimals) - 1) / scale) native units where scale = (10000-discountRate)/10000 * 10^(18-decimals). For USDC(6dp): 2% => 1e-6 USDC; 90% => 9e-6 USDC; 99.99% => ~0.01 USDC. Each claim burns exactly 1 NFT, so extracting a meaningful sum requires a proportional number of NFT burns (econ-gated).
conclusion.severityAssessment: Matches code-scan CODE-001: a real correctness defect, but value leak is sub-unit dust per claim and NFT-gated. Low/QA, not High. Recommended fix: add `if (actualPayment == 0) revert ZeroAmount();` after L498.
